# Copilot instructions for ElderLink

## Project summary
ElderLink is a Thai-language digital literacy app for older adults. It provides service guidance, short tutorials, favorites, accessibility settings, and emergency numbers in a calm and approachable UI.

## Tech stack
- React + Vite
- React Router DOM
- Lucide React
- Custom CSS

## Design expectations
- Simple, calm, familiar layouts
- Large buttons and text
- Strong contrast and readable typography
- Easy one-action flows and clear headings
- Avoid hard-to-read, overly technical text

## Implementation rules
- Preserve existing app structure and component patterns in src/App.jsx, src/pages.jsx, and src/components.jsx.
- Keep Thai copy friendly and practical.
- Prefer minimal edits and existing styling conventions.
- Maintain accessibility: semantic HTML, focus states, and clear labels.
- Respect localStorage keys for favorites and settings.

## Verification
Run npm run build before finishing changes.

## User value
The app should feel safe, reassuring, and easy to use for users who may not be confident with digital tools.
